title: Atmospheric Dispersion Surrogate Research: Closure and Closest-Match Scientific Chapters
description: This dated research update retains the 23 October 2026 practical no-go for the generic AERMOD surrogate product and publishes a retrospective mathematical account of the strongest restricted-domain matches. The new chapter separates genuinely predictive Gen1 Phase2H, Gen2 sealed high-confidence, targeted variable-stack, bounded multi-POINT and VOLUME, and within-year Gen3 V16 results from the truth-assisted V10–V12 oracle reconstructions. It records source parameters, meteorological and receptor conditions, equations, confidence-selection denominators, the distinction between whole-field and peak errors, and the correction that recovered 2019 Phase2H evidence was not pristine one-shot confirmation. Frozen scientific data and governed evidence remain unchanged. No regulatory equivalence or generic surrogate product success is claimed.
